The report indicates conversion rates of 11% from applicant to interview, 24% from interview to offer, and 68% for offer acceptance.

Please note a key limitation: these figures exclude referral candidates, which accounted for approximately 30% of engineering hires last year. As a result, this data does not reflect the performance for all engineering candidates, covering only those from the careers site and job boards during the first half of the year.

The material reports 1,840 tonnes CO2e for 2025, but this covers Scope 1 only (direct emissions from boilers and van fleet). Scope 2 (purchased electricity) and Scope 3 (supply chain and business travel) are not included, so this does not represent the total carbon footprint. For reference, purchased electricity alone was estimated at about 2,600 tonnes in 2024.
Standard parcels took 1.9 days on average to arrive. Rural postcodes were excluded, so this covers urban and suburban areas only. 83% arrived within 2 days.

Crash-free sessions were 99.6% in the first 14 days. The data comes from the beta channel only (3,900 testers), not the stable channel, and testers mostly use recent high-end phones. Image upload on Android 12 caused 38% of crashes.
